content.short: Ionic Protocol is the primary lending platform on the Mode network, offering optimized interest rates for LSTs.
content.description: Ionic Protocol is the definitive money market and lending platform built natively for the Mode Network, an Ethereum Layer 2 powered by the OP Stack. Designed for maximum capital efficiency, the protocol supports a wide range of assets, including Liquid Staking Tokens (LSTs), allowing users to earn optimized yields while maintaining liquidity. Deeply integrated with Mode's incentive structures, Ionic provides institutional-grade tools in a non-custodial environment. The platform focuses on professional risk management, aiming to be the central liquidity hub for the Mode ecosystem.
content.meta: Ionic Protocol provides decentralized lending and money market services on the Mode Network. Discover Ionic and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
